answer_1.quote: We evaluate our models on real-world generation tasks such as AlpacaEval and MT-Bench, and construct a multi-response dataset ... to assess alignment performance.

answer_2.quote: We use the win rate of policy models against SFT models as our primary metric, and also compute NDCG@k and reward model scores for evaluation.

answer_3.quote: In the General Benchmark pipeline, we evaluate our models using AlpacaEval and MT-Bench, where GPT-4 Turbo is employed as the standard judge model to determine which of the two responses exhibits higher quality.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a comprehensive human evaluation involving 20 raters on the Prolific platform. Each rater compared 15 pairs of model outputs, totaling 300 pairs across matchups (PPA vs SFT, PPA vs DPO, PPA vs LiPO).
answer_4.guideline: Raters were asked to choose the higher-quality response for each pair of generated outputs.
